Messages.Author: Wouter Kuyper
Messages.Body:
Hi Guys,

Another deck, based on daring the dawn, this time with Concordance...
I think it could use more prevention, and tel-misdirection maybe....what to do?

Deck Name: Giotto and friends
Created By: wk
Description: Concordance + daring_the_dawn, renewed vigor to fill up.
Clan imp to avoid scarce-cost and possible sanguine instruction.
pool gain is doll (with Blanche) and minion_tap + renewed_vigor.
No or very little blocking, dies to stealth-bleed, dies to rush

Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 25, Max: 28, Avg: 6.75)
----------------------------------------------
6 Giotto Verducci DAI for OBF pot pre 7, Baali (maybe 5?)
3 Matthias AUS FOR nec OBE 7, Salubri (could add one for telmisdirect)
3 Blanche Hill aus FOR OBE 6, Salubri

Library: (90 cards)
-------------------
Master (11 cards)
5 Blood Doll
1 Dreams of the Sphinx
1 Giant's Blood
4 Minion Tap

Action (29 cards)
5 Clan Impersonation (Maybe just pay for the Scarce-cost?)
7 Concordance (too many? I really want them..)
4 Condemnation: Doomed (too many?)
3 Contagion (mostly fun, too many?)
7 Renewed Vigor
3 Sanguine Instruction

Action Modifier (29 cards)
6 Cloak the Gathering
10 Daring the Dawn
4 Freak Drive
2 Lost in Crowds
3 Psychomachia (out probably...)
4 Repulsion (also playable by Giotto)

Combat (8 cards)
3 Conflagration (just for fun and surprise)
5 Skin of Steel

Retainer (3 cards)
3 D'habi Revenant (not unique)

Combo (10 cards)
10 Sense the Sin (versatile)

Ok, let me know what you think,

Wouter

Messages.Author: dancingmummy
Messages.Body:
wouter...@yahoo.com (Wouter Kuyper) wrote in message news:<155a2de5.02061...@posting.google.com>...

> Hi Guys,
>
> Another deck, based on daring the dawn, this time with Concordance...
> I think it could use more prevention, and tel-misdirection maybe....what to do?
>
>
> Deck Name: Giotto and friends
> Created By: wk
> Description: Concordance + daring_the_dawn, renewed vigor to fill up.
> Clan imp to avoid scarce-cost and possible sanguine instruction.
> pool gain is doll (with Blanche) and minion_tap + renewed_vigor.
> No or very little blocking, dies to stealth-bleed, dies to rush
>
> Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 25, Max: 28, Avg: 6.75)
> ----------------------------------------------
> 6 Giotto Verducci DAI for OBF pot pre 7, Baali (maybe 5?)
> 3 Matthias AUS FOR nec OBE 7, Salubri (could add one for telmisdirect)

I would say ditch Matthias. Your not using AUS or nec, and you said
you don't block much.

Another way of doing this deck entirely would be to scrap the Salubri
and go with Giotto, Suhailah, and 5th Tradition. They have great
discipline overlap (no more Repulsion--they both have OBF!), and once
Giotto dons his DAI Concordance, Suhailah can use others you have
sitting in your hand if you have massive intra-minion-phase hand jam
(IMPHJ).

> 3 Blanche Hill aus FOR OBE 6, Salubri
>
> Library: (90 cards)
> -------------------
> Master (11 cards)
> 5 Blood Doll
> 1 Dreams of the Sphinx
> 1 Giant's Blood
> 4 Minion Tap

You could use Fortitude Skill cards for Giotto. He works much better
at FOR. Also, you might consider some Stranger Among Us to ensure a
Blanche Hill.

>
> Action (29 cards)
> 5 Clan Impersonation (Maybe just pay for the Scarce-cost?)

Ditch these.

> 7 Concordance (too many? I really want them..)

These probably aren't too many. Giotto's special is ideal for the
deck that puts in lots of one card that you only need to play once.

> 4 Condemnation: Doomed (too many?)

Yup. Every Baali action is sacred, so you need to ask yourself if
each action is Better than Bleeding (BtB). I say ditch at least 2.

> 3 Contagion (mostly fun, too many?)

Ditch at least 2.

> 7 Renewed Vigor
> 3 Sanguine Instruction

Ditch all SI's.
You are missing two crucial action cards: Force of Will and Masochism.
Six of each is in the ballpark. Force of Will allows you to obviate
the Infernal cost. Masochism turns that damage from Force of Will and
Daring the Dawn into cost payment for future Forces of Will, Freak
Drives, Skins of Steel, or Kisses of Ra.

>
> Action Modifier (29 cards)
> 6 Cloak the Gathering
> 10 Daring the Dawn

Might be able to cut 1 or 2 Daring the Dawns. I've found that people
give up blocking Giotto after awhile, since they have to pay one blood
just to try. You might consider ditching some stealth. You might
also consider adding one Kiss of Ra. Just seeing it in your ash heap
will make people reconsider blocking you.

> 4 Freak Drive

More of these.

> 2 Lost in Crowds
> 3 Psychomachia (out probably...)
> 4 Repulsion (also playable by Giotto)

Again, an advantage of teh Suhailah/5th tradition module is that all
of your stealth can come from the same discipline.

>
> Combat (8 cards)
> 3 Conflagration (just for fun and surprise)

Ditch at least 1.

> 5 Skin of Steel

Might consider adding some damage prevention that doesn't cost blood,
like Unflinching Persisance or Rolling with the Punches. Then again,
if you can get Masochism going, Skin of Steel is just fine.

>
> Retainer (3 cards)
> 3 D'habi Revenant (not unique)

I don't think I'd go with more than 2. I know you can stack them, but
you also have to take an action to put them on.

>
> Combo (10 cards)
> 10 Sense the Sin (versatile)

It is versatile, but you might want to shave off 1 or 2. It's
annoying how that card can multiply in your hand.

Are you sure you don't want to play with any Wakes? Even two is
better than nothing.

>
>
>
> Ok, let me know what you think,

I'm glad other people out there are thinking about this kind of deck!
Maybe we can get it into a workable version.

Wide-eyed optimism for the Baali,
dancingmummy

>
> Wouter

Messages.Author: Emmanuel Martin
Messages.Body:
I needed a little time to understand the combo, which is quite good.
My point would be : why the two Salubri. You should try your deck with
both Sethite sand Khobar towers.

Small Sethites may use your concordances, play obfuscate and allow you
to put Khobar towers. For combat, Giotto has access to the powerfull
disarm, which is very efficient combined with fortitude.

Anarch revolt will fasten the game, thus preventing opponets from
finding solution (say bloating). There is a whole bunch of master
cards which have to flow nicely if you want to stand a chance.

This game as a taste of bleed stealth, and this is voluntary. A bounce
hevy deck will of course be your nemesis. The deck is short, as game
should be short too. Game shouldn't be allowed to last more than 9
turns.

Here is a very fragile version of the deck, that could however give
bad surprises to many uncautious opponents. What is sure is that if
you play this deck, things won't last more than half an hour for you.

This deck dies to many things, but can be a efficient bleeder. In case
of a stelth blead race, canibalizing your vampires to the Khobar
Towers might givve you the afvantage.

With Giotto for 4-5 (Base bleed + Sense the Sin + Action card or not)
and a Sthite concording for 1, and one anrch revolt, you should rip
6-7 pool out of your prey every turn. So yes, you'll have to pay one
as Giotto is infernal, but has you ssee it's not a major concern.

Perhaps cards like life boon or major boon could be efficient in such
a deck ? Sure bleed defense is not its focus point but hey, the same
holds true to a weenie presence horde. And at least you may bloat a
little. Of course this deck has to be tested but can perhaps proove
violent.

The deck is 63 cards, though it should be optimised to 60 ASAP

Combat 6
Skin of steel * 3
Putrefaction * 1
Disarm * 2
(to slow bruise&something decks, or mono vampire Theo or Best rushers,
or cross table rushers that my think twice of rushing you if one of
their guys gets his ass properly kicked)

Action 15
Concordance * 7
Contagion * 2 (with freak drive, a free additional AR is a
must)
Entrancement * 2 (for allies ... or increased bleed)
Legal Manipulation * 4

Action modifier 20
Daring the dawn * 7
Freak Drive * 4 (apart from bleeding you shuld play
conatgion, sup Entrancement, conccordance)
Sense the sin * 7 (yes, bleed is part of the deck)
Lost in crowds * 1 (easy to cycle)
Cloak the gathering * 1

Reaction * 2

Delaying tactics * 2 (hould help the ARs to last at least a little)

Master * 20

Parthenon * 4
Khobar Towers * 3 (you don't need it on first turn)
Anarch Revolt * 6
Info Highway * 3
Secure Haven * 1 (Legends say that sometimes infamous people
rush)
Dreams of the sphinx * 1
The Coven * 1
Succubus club * 1 ( Succubus club
+ Khobar towers combo can be very efficient)

Crypt

1 Lalitha
1 Celine Chevalier
1 Khalil Anvari
1 Antoinette Duchamp
2 Nepatha
6 Giotto Verducci

Emmanuel Martin

Messages.Author: HD
Messages.Body:
>
> Wouter Kuyper wrote...

>
> Hi Guys,
>
> Another deck, based on daring the dawn, this time with Concordance...
> I think it could use more prevention, and tel-misdirection maybe....what to do?

I don't usually comment on decks because I still have so much to learn
about this game, so take all my thoughts with a grain of salt... But
I'll give it a try since I have a few ideas you might like (who
knows?).

> Deck Name: Giotto and friends
> Created By: wk
> Description: Concordance + daring_the_dawn, renewed vigor to fill up.
> Clan imp to avoid scarce-cost and possible sanguine instruction.
> pool gain is doll (with Blanche) and minion_tap + renewed_vigor.
> No or very little blocking, dies to stealth-bleed, dies to rush
>
> Crypt: (12 cards, Min: 25, Max: 28, Avg: 6.75)
> ----------------------------------------------
> 6 Giotto Verducci DAI for OBF pot pre 7, Baali (maybe 5?)
> 3 Matthias AUS FOR nec OBE 7, Salubri (could add one for telmisdirect)
> 3 Blanche Hill aus FOR OBE 6, Salubri

You could take one from each of these ( 5 Goitto Verducci, 2 Matthias,
2 Blanch Hill) and add Basil, Normal, and Dimple. Then put in a few
Kiss of Ra and use the little stealth minions to diablirize any of
your prey's minions that are giving you fits. If you add a few skill
masters (fortitude?), the smaller minons will become even more useful
(if they make it into your ready region). This crypt looks limiting
since you might only get 2 minions out. I like to have more options
than that.

> Library: (90 cards)
> -------------------
> Master (11 cards)

You can probably get away with a few more masters

> 5 Blood Doll

How about 6 or 7 blood dolls, so you can take blood off AND put it
back on in a pinch. That way you can dump the Minion Taps and you'll
have even more room for other masters. Or you can go with 2 Blood
Dolls and 6 Minion Taps (if you're sure that you'll be able to get the
Renewed Vigors through

BTW - I like the idea of using Suhallia and 5th traditions instead...
or maybe use Nikolaus Vermeulen and Selma The Repugnant so you can do
more with Fortitude, Potence, or the other Traditions... and then you
would be able justify including Mary The Black since she has
Potence... or even Murat combined with the High Priest Angra Mainyu
for surpentis options - of course these are totally different decks,
but they are still fun to talk about).

> 1 Dreams of the Sphinx

One more?

> 1 Giant's Blood
> 4 Minion Tap

Either dump all of these some of the Blood Dolls for Sudden Reversals
(2 or 3?) and some masters that will give you blood consistently (a
Powerbase or evensomething like Blood Puppy)

> Action (29 cards)
> 5 Clan Impersonation (Maybe just pay for the Scarce-cost?)

Does that work? Is it worth it? I can't really comment on this
because I haven't used it, but something seems wrong here. It looks
like this would make it too easy to avoid their handicap... and gain a
hunting ground... or votes... or whatever... Anyone??

> 7 Concordance (too many? I really want them..)

Great card, but maybe only 5? Seven seems like a slight overkill to
me even though it's pretty important for this deck.

> 4 Condemnation: Doomed (too many?)]

Excellent card if you can intercept and block consistently. (more?)

> 3 Contagion (mostly fun, too many?)

This might cause the table to single your minions out for immediate
destruction. Keep them if you're meta game doesn't see a lot of rush
combat decks, but I would probably stick to only one or two (held in
reserve until near the end of the game? They will attack you anyway
when it's down to 2 or 3 players, right?).

> 7 Renewed Vigor
> 3 Sanguine Instruction

What are you teaching and why? Stealth for Matthias and Blanch? This
could be accomplished with skill masters if you have the master slots
for them and really need to focus your actions else where (only two
minons?). However, it might be fine if you have a lot of Freak Drives
and can untap with Concordiance.

> Action Modifier (29 cards)
> 6 Cloak the Gathering

Maybe some more diversity in your stealth so you can play one on top
of the other? I'd be tempted to add a few Lost in Crowds, Faceless
Night, Elder Impersonation, etc. and some Obfuscate skill cards or
more Sanguine Instructions. (I'm playing in an environment that has a
LOT of intercept and combat, but this may not apply to your situation
as much)

> 10 Daring the Dawn

Wow. Daywalkers... :o)

> 4 Freak Drive

6 Freak Drives? (if you're only going to have 2 minions out)

> 2 Lost in Crowds

I'd go with 4 of these.

> 3 Psychomachia (out probably...)

You already have stealth and you actually want them to block you most
of the time... but I'd also be tempted to leave a couple in there
just in case (predator). However, I would also hate to get this in my
hand at the wrong time instead of a Daring the Dawn - Skin of Steel
combo. You'll probably have to play it a few times to see how it
works for you.

> 4 Repulsion (also playable by Giotto)

If these are blocked, then Matthias might end up in torpor. Suhalia
or the Nosferatu are looking even better...

> Combat (8 cards)
> 3 Conflagration (just for fun and surprise)

More?

> 5 Skin of Steel

I think that I would go with a larger variety of fortitude... or at
least a couple more Skin of Steel. I hate the idea of having a Daring
the Dawn backfire on me. There is a lot of fortitude floating around
out there nowadays: they block, prevent your damage, press... or
manuever to distance and hit you with weapons, use quietus, or steal
blood/walk of flame....)

> Retainer (3 cards)
> 3 D'habi Revenant (not unique)

Only if you can afford the actions. Putting in 1 Taha Morgan and 1
T.S. Esquire gives you some more versatility if you're not worried
about contesting. Matthias with an increased bleed and a Kiss or Ra
threat could be nice.

> Combo (10 cards)
> 10 Sense the Sin (versatile)

Great card, but only if you plan to block a lot. It goes well with
Comdemnation: Doomed, but it doesn't fit in as well with your Dawn
Operations. How are you going to cause serious damage after you
block?

Why didn't you add any tel-misdirection that you mentioned above?
That seems like a good idea to me. You're a little weak without the
Daring the Dawn and your predator might really hurt you with rush
combat, stealth bleed, or whatever. How do you handle votes? I may
have missed something, but it seems like there might be some holes
that need to be filled.

I'd also try to find a way to increase your bloat to offset the
Baali's inherent weakness. Maybe another minon with a Palacial Estate
and a blood doll? Or some Taste of Vitae with increased damage
(potence?)... or something. It seems like your predator/prey could
just watch you slowly waste away while causing you fits here and
there.

> Ok, let me know what you think,
>
> Wouter

It looks like a fun deck to play and I'd like to hear how it works for
you (with whatever changes you do or don't make). I'm looking forward
to finding a really good use for the Baali. Good Luck!

Cheers,
Howard

PS I hope these comments were somewhat interesting or helpful. I
don't usually do this and I'm not sure if I've done a very good job.
Check everything I've said with someone else and ingnore anything that
sounds wrong or incomplete.

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 17 Jun 2002 21:25:54 -0700, hdma...@hotmail.com (HD) wrote:

>> Action (29 cards)
>> 5 Clan Impersonation (Maybe just pay for the Scarce-cost?)

>Does that work?

Yes.
If Matthias becomes a Baali (or any other clan), then you don't have
any scarce Salubri in play when you bring out Blanche and you save
three pool.

> Is it worth it?

Yes.

>> 7 Renewed Vigor
>> 3 Sanguine Instruction

>What are you teaching and why?

Obeah and Daimoinon.
Whichever is appropriate. Until all the vampires can play all of the
cards, the deck is extremely fragile.

>You already have stealth and you actually want them to block you most
>of the time... but I'd also be tempted to leave a couple in there
>just in case (predator). However, I would also hate to get this in my
>hand at the wrong time instead of a Daring the Dawn - Skin of Steel
>combo. You'll probably have to play it a few times to see how it
>works for you.

Daring the Dawn - Skin of Steel is not a combo, the two cards do not
and cannot interact in any way.

The combo is Concordance - Daring the Dawn, treating all aggravated
damage as normal damage allows Giotto's actions to be unblockable
except to allies.

>> 4 Repulsion (also playable by Giotto)

>If these are blocked, then Matthias might end up in torpor. Suhalia
>or the Nosferatu are looking even better...

Repulsion is not an action, you play it as an action modifier on some
other action to permanently gain +1 stealth.

>Great card, but only if you plan to block a lot. It goes well with
>Comdemnation: Doomed, but it doesn't fit in as well with your Dawn
>Operations. How are you going to cause serious damage after you
>block?

There aren't any Dawn Operations in the deck.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nikolaj Wendt wrote:
> I cant see why Clan Impersonation should prevent the Scarce cost (since
> CI only changes the clan) if it doesnt prevent the "Infernal" cost.

A CI'ed scarce vampire is still scarce. He just happens to be of a
different clan (which helps when bring out other scarce vampires).

If you bring out a scarce Salubri and CI him to be a Brujah, then you
have a scarce Brujah.

If you bring out another scarce Salubri, you pay 3 pool for every other
*Salubri* in play. The scarce Brujah is not Salubri, so won't increase
your penalty.

They are not "immune to aggravated damage".
Concordance allows the Baali to treat the aggravated damage
as normal damage. Normal damage will still send the Baali to torpor.

Independent vampires cannot become princes, nor may they even
attempt to call the vote. A Clan Impersonated Giotto, or a Giotto
with a Writ of Acceptance could become a prince.
